Architecture note

One API for mobile and web

Where to put shared rules when two apps use the same data.

City Sheba’s mobile and web clients share an Express API. Put authorization and validation in the API so every client follows the same rules.

For example, the API should determine whether a signed-in user has a donor profile before letting them create a donation organization. Each client can explain the requirement in its own interface.
